headline: Seed pinning reaches 38 titles
lede: Two more batches of the seed contract landed tonight: five classic engines plus Garden Guard and Robot Lab now report their run seed and replay it from ?seed=N — after an audit that refused to fake a seed on the nine ports whose sim ignores it.

notes.text: Batch 5 (merged 4468ff1): Emberwood, ViperPit (offline), CivilizationV, Myst and PickRush wired to the seed-report + pin contract, with BardsTale reporting seedless — its six dungeons are fixed floors by design. Floor 31 -> 36.

Batch 6 (merged 8cd8f97): Garden Guard and Robot Lab — both engines were genuinely seeded all along (a deterministic-from-one-integer sim and a mulberry32 robot physics) but rolled wall-clock entropy at human start and reported nothing. Now ?seed=N replays the exact garden or workbench, and both stream {tick,score,done,seed} to the feedback sensor. Floor 36 -> 38.

The fake-seed audit: nine ports (Galaga, IceClimber, BoulderDash, Paperboy, Joust, MetroidLite, Dogfight, MissileBattle, Polarity) carry an old contractSeed that their sim never consults — gameplay runs on raw Math.random. Pinning them would print a replay number that changes nothing, so they wait for real engine seed-params instead of a lie in the HUD.
The remaining #1473 scope is design work, not plumbing: engine-level seeding for the Math.random ports, seedless report passes for fixed-world titles, and RallyCoDriver after its lobby issue ships.
